tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (shrī)༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /mi 'gyur bde chen rang bzhin chos kyi sa
(shrī)༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /mi 'gyur bde chen rang bzhin chos kyi sa

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag bzhugs so// ༄༅// mi 'gyur bde chen rang bzhin chos kyi sku// rnam dag sgyu ma'i gar mdzad drag mo'i gzugs// rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong mdzad bcom ldan ma// dmag zor rgyal mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum la ji ltar 'jug cing nyams su blang ba'i tshul khrigs su bsdeb pa ni 'di ltar shes par bya'o// bsnyen sgrub las gsum la 'jug pa'i tshul dngos brjod par bya ste/ de yang bsnyen sgrub las gsum zhes pa'i go don ni/ 'jig rten pha rol po dang g.yul 'gyed par nus pa'i dpung gi tshogs rnams la thog mar/ zas gos dang yul zhing sogs du ma zhig byin nas yun ring du mgu bar byed pa lhur len pa ltar/ dam tshig dang sdom pa legs par bsrung zhing*/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang bzlas brjod mchod gtor sogs la yun ring du 'bad nas/ lha mnyes shing rang la nye bar byed pa'i sbyor ba la 'bad par byed pa ni bsnyen pa'o// de nas pha rol po dang g.yul 'gyed pa'i phyir du dpung gi tshogs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ go bskon pa dang mtshon cha chas su 'jug pa sogs byed pa dang 'dra bar bsnyen pa tshad du thengs nas/ las la sbyor ba'i nye rgyu ling ga dang*/ rdzas dang sman dang 'brub khung dang thun la sogs pa chas su gzhug cing*/ las la sbyor ba'i nye rgyu lhag ma rnams dang*/ las 'di la sbyor ba'i thugs rings par skul ba'i bzlas pa'i rnam pa gzhan byed pa ni sgrub pa'o// de nas dmag gi tshogs de dag g.yul 'gyed pa dang 'dra bar las de dang de las dngos su sbyor ba'i bzlas pa dang cho ga la zhugs pa ni las sbyor ro// de nas g.yul bkye ba'i dbang gis pha rol po pham par byas pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ yul 'khor thob pa sogs dang 'dra ba ni las la sbyar ba'i 'bras bu 'grub pa ste/

rgyud sde chen po rnams las 'di'i don tha snyad gnyis ka dngos su yod pa dang*/ dngos su med kyang don tshang bar yod pas/ 'di'i skabs su lha'i rnal 'byor/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ rdzas sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par zhib par shes shing*/ bsnyen pa gnad du song ma song gi rtags dang tshad/ sgrub pa gnad du song ma song*/ las sbyor la dngos su 'jug ran ma ran gyi rtags dang tshad/ las la sbyar bas dgos pa 'grub mi 'grub kyi rtags dang tshad/ grub nas ji ltar bya ba dang*/ ma grub na spogs chog ji ltar bya ba sogs kyi rnam dbye legs par shes dgos so// de ltar min na ngal ba 'bras bu med pa'am/ 'bras bu log par 'byin pa gang rung las mi 'da'o// de ltar na 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum nyams su len pa la bzhi/ gang du nyams su len pa'i gnas/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag gang gi phyir nyams su len pa'i dgos pa/ ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ grib can dang dam nyams gnas pa'i sa ma yin pa/ nag phyogs la dga' ba'i mi dang mi ma yin gdug pa can mi gnas pa/ dben zhing 'du 'dzi dang bral ba/ dur khrod la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba'i gnas sam/ rang yid dang mthun pa'i spyil bu sogs so// gnyis pa gang zag ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par 'dzin pa'o// dam tshig dang sdom pa yal bar 'dor ba ni chos skyong gis spong ba yin te/ zla gsang thig le las/ lha rnams kyang ni dam nyams kyi// gsol yang bzhes su mi gnang ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas bka' bsgo ba dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i lung dang*/ man ngag sogs kyi lung legs par thob cing nyams su len pa'i gnad la mkhas pas nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa dgos pa ni/ rang nyid kyi rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs dang zang zing gi phyir ma yin par/

snying thag pa nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i don gyi phyir dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gces par 'dzin pa'i blos bshad sgrub la zhugs tsam nyid nas bdud dang bdud kyis yid bsgyur ba'i skye bo dag gis sgo sna tshogs nas bar du gcod par 'gyur bas/ de dag gi 'gal rkyen sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phyir srung ma khyad par can 'di lta bu la brten nas 'gal rkyen sel ba dang mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phyir du yin gyi/ de las gzhan du ma yin no// bzhi pa ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa las la sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas phyag drug pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag nas ji skad bshad pa ltar 'dir yang phal cher rung bas/ de la gtor ma dang 'brel ba dang*/ ma 'brel ba'i skabs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zhag re la thun bzhi'am drug tu gtor ma dang bzlas pa 'brel ba re zhig pa'i nyams len gyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ thun tha ma 'ba' zhig la byed pa'i rgyun ldan pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// dang po la me lce 'bar ma'i rgyud kyi le'u bzhi pa las/ mthing nag gru bzhi'i dbus na e gru gsum// tshon rtsi mi rus ldong ros rams dang skag /dbus su zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bri ba dang 'brel ba dang*/ gtor ma 'ba' zhig la brten pa'o// dang po maṇ+ḍal bca' gzhi 'og tu gtor sgrub kyi skabs su 'chad la/ 'dir maṇ+ḍal ni/ khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du rlung nag 'tshub mar 'tshubs pa'i gur gyi nang du mthing nag gru bzhi pa'i dbus su e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i nang du/ bse mkhar smug po gru bzhi pa/ zur bzhi smug po mchongs las byas pa/ kha bad sngon po g.yu las byas pa/ rmang gzhi nag po lcags las byas pa'i nang du/ mngon rtogs bzhin bsgoms pa'i mdun du gtor ma rnams phyag len bzhin du bshams la/

dus ji tsam byas pa'i ring la mtshams shin tu dam par bcad/ thun mtshams su'ang mtshams g.yog nges pa can min pa mi 'phrad/ ngag mi bsre/ grib can dang*/ dam nyams dang*/ rang gi bla ma sogs dang 'khon yod pa'i lag nas byung ba'i sgrub rdzas dang bza' btung sogs kyi yo byad mi len no// de nas gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas dang*/ bris sku dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten/ spos sbyar ma/ rdor dril/ cang te'u sogs med du mi rung ba'i yo byad rnams 'tshogs par byas la/ yar ngo'i tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ bco lnga sogs gang rung la gza' dang*/ skar ma dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ byed pa bzang po la thog mar brtsam par bya'o// de nas yi dam gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs par bsgoms te bzlas pa cung zhig bya zhing mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba sogs byas nas mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma 'bul/ dngos grub zhus/ de nas lha mo bskyed pa ni/ bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥ zhes sogs brjod/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ maṇ+ḍal stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur gyi nang du/ 'og gzhi mthing nag gru bzhi pa'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i dbus su dre'u rkyang ser gwa pa'i steng du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor gyi rgyal mo zhes sogs mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed nas/ spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa/ skong gso rnams thun dang sbyar la rgyas par bya/ de nas bsnyen pa la 'jug pa na/ me lce 'bar ma'i le'u brgyad pa las/ sngags zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro'i srog rtsa yin// grangs kyang mang la zur yang ma chag ste// gug skyed tsheg drag dag kyang ma nor na// lha mo nag mo dngos su 'grub pa yin// ces gsungs pa bzhin bsnyen pa byed dgos so// rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/
lha mo'i thugs ka'i bh+yoḥl phog pas thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul bas ci 'dod pa'i las rab 'byams 'grub par bsams la/ bh+yoḥ

rbad pa/ rak+mo snying khrag la/ bh+yoḥ rak+mo snying khrag la/ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ nyams pa'i snying khrag la rol/ kha la raka dmar nag ma chen mo/ chen mo/ rak+mo a khrag 'thung ma khyod kyis rol/ bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ myur du myur du/ thugs byin gyis rlobs/ hūm̐/ yang sngags phreng rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba zhal nas thon/ lha mo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i bh+yoḥl thim/ lte ba nas byung*/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs hūm̐ la thim/ mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams kha dog sngo nag me 'od 'phro ba/ myur ba/ drag la rtsub pa can du rtse gcig tu dmigs te bzlas pa bya'o// lhag chad kyi nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa ci mang bzlas so// de ltar thun re la ji tsam bzla ba'i ring la rang dang lha mo'i chos nyid la dbye ba cung zad kyang med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du ro gcig kyang*/ gdug pa can 'dul ba'i don du stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi gzung rnams shin tu drag tu khros pa'i khro mo'i gzugs can snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i skur shar ba yang yang dran par byas te/ mgyogs pa dang*/ bul ba dang ma dag pa'i skyon bsal te rtse gcig pa'i dmigs pa rno zhing smra brjod drag pos bzla bar bya'o// bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub dag /ces sogs dang gong du smos pa de'i phyir ro// grangs ni/ 'bar ma las/ sa ya bzlas na ma mo mngon du 'ong*// bye ba bzlas na phyag rgya ston par byed// 'bum phrag dag gis dngos grub mtshan ma ster// ces gsungs so// de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la gtor chog ltar 'bul/ phrin las bcol/ bstod bskul rgyas par bya/ thun dang po la de ltar byas nas/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa rnams la rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/ bsnyen pa la gtso bor 'bad pa yin no// de nas sgrub pa ma thon gyi ring la chos skyong 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol ba dang*/

bris sku la bstim pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mtshan ma la brtan bzhugs gang yang mi byed par sgrub khang de na chos skyong 'khor bcas dngos su khra phung nge bzhugs par bsam mo// thun rjes ma rnams la gsar du bskyed pa min sngar gyi de kha la gsal btab nas bsgom pa yin no// de ltar zhag dang zla ba dang lo la sogs su thun bzhi'am drug drug gang byed kyang thun tha ma la cho ga rgyas par byas/ bstod bskul zin nas/ gtor mar grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar btsugs/ thog khar khyer/ gso bran byas/ byin gyis brlabs te/ bh+yoḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las la// zhes sogs dkyus ltar brjod/ gtor ma gshegs/ rjes chog byas/ mnga' gsol shis brjod sogs bya'o// ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// gnyis pa rgyun gyi nyams len gyi dbang du bya ba ni/ 'dzin gtor la brten te dgong mo'am/ srod la thun rer cho ga tshang ba re'i skabs su grangs 'di tsam mam/ de'i bsnyen pa nar mar byed tshul gong du brjod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa gtor ma dang 'brel ba rgyun bsnyen gyi bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ mdun du skad cig gis lha mo bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ byang shar mu le ding gi rgya mtsho chen po nas dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ bh+yoḥ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rum na// zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par byas/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bshags pa rnams byas/ skong gso bsdus pa cig byed/ de nas bsnyen pa nyid bya'o// mchod bstod byas/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba'am bzhag ste/ bya ba gzhan la 'jug go /bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba brjod zin to// bsnyen pa'i tshad ni gong du brjod pa dang*/ gzhan yang mtshan ma dang*/

grangs dang*/ dus kyi bsnyen pa'o// mtshan ma la rab dngos/ 'bring nyams snang*/ tha ma rmi lam du lha mo'i sku mthong ba dang*/ bud med nag mo dang*/ mon mo nag mo dngos sam nyams snang la mthong ba dang*/ khyi nag rta nag lug nag g.yag nag bya nag mang po mthong ba de dag ni nye ba'i rtags so// gtor ma dang sgrub rdzas sgrub khang sogs su 'od dang*/ me 'bar ba dang thog 'tsheg pa dang*/ sgra snyan cing yid du 'ong ba dang*/ dri zhim po rnams rang la 'khor ba'i rtags so// bla ma dang*/ bud med rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa dang*/ mi dpon dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs kyis bza' btung ster ba/ thod par chang 'thung ba/ mi'i sha za ba/ dar 'phyar ba/ dung 'bud pa/ nyi zla shar ba sogs ni dngos grub kyi rtags yin/ bud med rgyan med mang po ngu ba sogs ni ldog pa'i rtags yin/ mtshon cha chag pa/ rol mo chag pa/ mdze pho dang mi gtsang ba sogs ni nyams grib kyi rtags yin/ grangs ni bye ba'o gsungs/ dus bsnyen byed pa der med do// zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum thams cad gtor mar rag las pas/ thugs dam skong ba phrin las bcol ba thams cad gtor ma 'bul nas byed dgos pas/ gtor ma'i gnad shes pa gal che'o// des na sgrub khang sogs su dus rtag tu 'jog pa'i gtor ma la rtag gtor zer/ lo'am zla ba'i bar du bzhag nas lo zad zla zad kyi nyer dgu'am/ rang gnas 'pho ba'i tshe bsdu ba ni rten gtor ram 'dzin gtor zer/ nub re bzhin gsar du 'bul ba la 'phral gtor zer/ dus lo gsar pa'i tshes gcig brgyad/ bcu/ bcu bzhi/ bco lnga/ nyi zla shar nub kyi zer rnams la 'bul ba ni dus gtor zer ro// mar ngo'am/ nad dang gdon dang dgra dang bar chad dang rkyen ngan glo bur gnod pa byung ba'i tshe gtor ma 'phral du bshams nas phul te/ dus de nyid du gtong ba ni glo bur las bcol gyi gtor ma zer ro// gtor ma shin tu bzang bar bshams te/

thun bzhi'am drug tu bso/ byin gyis brlabs nas las grub pa'i mtshan ma brtan po ma byung gi bar thebs gcig kyang mi 'bul mi bsngo bar bzhag nas/ zhag re la 'phral gtor thun bzhi'am drug tu 'bul la/ las 'di dang 'di myur du sgrubs shig de grub na gtor ma 'di'ang gtang rag tu 'bul lo// zhes gtor ma gtel par 'dzin pas na gta' gtor zer ro// gtor ma lhar bskyed pa la thun gtor du bstabs nas/ bar chad sel zhing dngos grub zhu ba'i gtor sgrub dang*/ gtor ma lhar bskyed thun bzhi'am drug tu thun gtor bstab/ sgrub pa zhag ci rigs byas/ mthar gtor chen dgra bgegs kyi phyogs su brdeg gtor du byed pa ni 'di'i lugs kyi gtor chen zhes bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa las so so dang mthun pa'i sgrub pa bshad pa la gnyis/ 'jam po gsum dang mthun pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ drag po mthu'i sgrub pa'o// zhi rgyas dbang gsum la bar chad sel ba'i gtor sgrub gtso che/ drag po la gtor chen dang*/ mdos chen gtso che ba yin no// dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis gtor ma'i bsham tshul/ 'bul ba'i dmigs pa/ bzlas pa'i sngags/ phrin las bcol tshul rnams mi 'dra'o// de'i dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug go /dang po ni/ gnas khang gtsang zhing dben par mtshams dam par bcad/ phyag dar byi dor legs par byas/ yol ba bla re spyan gzigs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten/ mdor na yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas/ dri bzang dang ba'i rnam lnga byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal zlum po dang*/ gru bzhi dang*/ zla gam dang*/ gru gsum pa sogs bya'o// de'i steng du mañji la sogs pa'i steng du zangs sogs gas chag med pa'i snod bzang por gtor ma dpal gtor zlum po thebs kyu nyer gcig gis bskor ba bcad kha nang du bstan pa/ mdun du dpal lha/ g.yas su chu srin gdong can gyi/ g.yon du seng ge'i gdong can gyi/ dpal lha'i mdun du dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i/

chu srin gdong can gyi g.yas su dbyar gyi rgyal mo'i/ rgyab tu ston gyi rgyal mo'i/ seng ge'i gdong can gyi g.yon tu dgun gyi rgyal mo'i/ yang de'i mdun du zhi ba'i lha mo'i/ g.yas/ rgyab/ g.yon du rim bzhin rgyas pa'i lha dang dbang dang drag po'i lha mo'i/ de'i yang mdun du tshe ring mched lnga'i/ g.yas su bdud mo bzhi/ rgyab tu sman mo bzhi/ g.yon du gnod sbyin mo bzhi'i/ rgyab kyi g.yas la yi dam gyi gtor ma/ g.yon la gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/ de thams cad snod gcig la mtha' ma thebs kyus 'khor bar bskor ba ni lhag ma rnams kyi'o// thams cad rgyu bzang ba bkod pa mdzes par bsham/ 'dis gzhan la'ang 'gre'o// gtor ma'i rgyab tu gtor ma las mtho ba'i bris sku bkram/ de rnams mdun du mchod rdzas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus thod pa la mtshan ldan nal thod kyi nang du phud ma nyams pa la bdud rtsi'i ril bu dang*/ gur gum/ gi waṃ/ ga bur/ tsan+dan dkar dmar sogs sman bzang po dri bsung can btab ste stegs bu'i khar bzhag khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po'i me tog gsur chen gyi dud pa/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ zhal zas bshos bu dmar nag sha chen gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dril bu sogs rol mo/ khyad par du de rnams mdun nam gong du skong gtor la yang snying khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa'i nang mchod gri snying tsaka lis brgyan pa/ 'phral gtor gsum/ gshegs gtor gcig rnams bsham/ khyad par du tshil chen dang cong zhi sbyar ba'i spos sogs yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa cho ga ji ltar bya zhing gtor ma phul nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ thog mar yi dam gyi sgom bzlas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma rnams phul/ mchod gtor bdud rtsi myang ba sogs byas/ rnam dag bsam pas tshul 'dir 'bad pa las sogs brjod/ de nas mchod rdzas dang*/ skong rdzas dang*/ gtor chen ma gtogs pa'i thun gtor rnams byin gyis brlab/

bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin lha mo 'khor bcas mngon rtogs sngar bzhin rgyas par bskyed/ spos sbyor bsreg thod rnga sogs rol mo'i sgra dang*/ dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ gtor ma phul la bstod/ yig brgya bshags pa dang bcas pa byas/ skong gso bskul dang bcas pa byed/ yang gtor ma 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi dmigs pa zur du yod pa bzhin no// zhes pa 'jam po gsum gyi skabs su bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i bh+yoḥsogs la phog thugs rgyud bskul bas yul khams dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang*/ gang la dmigs par bya ba'i nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par rang gi thos bsam sgom gsum sogs bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar byas snyam du bsams la/ bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ kha la rag chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ che ge mo'i nad gdon tshe'i bar chad/ bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la bar du gcod pa rnams shān+tiṃ ku ru na maḥ zhes bzla'o// rgyas pa la rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i bh+yoḥsogs la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer kha dog ser po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can nam/ yang na thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gser 'od 'phro ba lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ srid pa gsum gyi bkrag mdangs/ gzi brjid/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus te gtor ma la thim pas/ tshe bsod nams thos bsam sgom gsum thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ kha la rag chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ swā hā/

che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams/ bshad sgrub kyi bya ba/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan/ nor longs spyod sogs yid la bsams pa'i don thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// dbang la rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i bh+yoḥsogs la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas lha mo dmar mo lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi phun tshogs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rgyal po sogs skye bo rnams kyi snying ga lha klu gnod sbyin mo/ gang la dmigs pa'i bud med kyi skye gnas su btab/ rang dbang med par bkug la mgo'i cod pan gyis rang gi rkang pa la gtugs te ji ltar bgo ba nyan par bsams la/ bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ kha la rag chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ dzaḥ rgyal po la sogs pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ sngags mthar/ hrīḥ lha mo sogs dang bud med che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya hrīḥ zhes bzla'o// 'di ni dgyes bzhin gnang bas gter ltar sbos*/ 'di'i skabs su brgyad pa dgos pa gzhan du btsal bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar thun bzhi'am drug tu sngags bzlas shing gtor ma phul te skong ba rgyas par bya'o// de nas gshegs gtor phul/ rjes chog bya/ mnga' gsol shis brjod bya'o// gnyis pa drag po dpe gcig la rdzas rus pa snang brtag mchan/ dang 'brel ba'i gtor chen ji ltar bya ba ni/ 'bar ma'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa las/ gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gnas gzhi'i sa la bya// tshon rtsi mi rus ldong ros rams dang skag /mthing nag gru bzhi'i dbus na e gru gsum// zhes gsungs pas/ stegs bu dpangs su khru gang pa/ rgyar phyogs re rer khru do do yod pa'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum pa rtse nub na bstan pas 'og na brus pa'am/ bri ba'i gzhi

ro sol dang rus pa nag po/ nag po la/ chos 'byung dmar dmar ser/ nag bris pa tshon gyis kha bsgyur/ de'i mdun du 'brub khung zur gsum pa zur gcig phar bstan pa/ phyi'i stegs bu la rtsangs nyer gcig srin mo 'gros su bskor/ de'i steng du ro g.yam la rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i lte bar bug pa yod pas kha bcad/ dug dang khrag chen dang*/ nad rigs gang gis shi 'dod pa'i khrag dang ro sol gyis nag por byug gang la bya ba'i ling ga dpe'u chung ltar bris/ zag rdzas kyis byug kha sbyar dbye ba sogs byas/ nang du gzhug de'i steng du phur sgrub byas la ro skra'i gzungs thag gis sbrel ba snying gar btsugs/ thun sogs kyang sta gon bya/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum mda' gang ba byas la/ de'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum me ri rlung nag 'tshub mas bskor ba la dug khrag gis byug de'i steng du khrag chang bsres pa'i dpal bshos gtor ma gru gsum khru gang las mi chung ba/ gtor bran brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mtha' theb kyu nyer gcig gi bcad kham phyir bstan nas mtshams dam par byas/ khrag gis brgyan pa mañji sogs kyi khar bzhag mdun du'ang mchod gtor rnams dang skong rdzas tshogs par byas la/ de nas nang mchod gtor chen byin gyis brlab/ bskyed chog rnams gong dang 'dra la/ khyad par bzlas pa'i skabs su/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i bh+yoḥl phog drag tu khros/ sprul pa nam mkha' gang bar spros/ dgra bgegs thams cad bsad bcad gtubs brlag par byas la/ sprul pa rnams kyis sha khrag kyang zos par bsams la/ snying po'i mjug tu hūm̐ phaṭa dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ mtshams 'dir ling ga kha sbyar dbye ba byas/ ling ga ral gris gtubs/ sha khrag dang bcas pa thun bzhir zhag ji tsam byed pa'i ring la phul/ thun mtha' ma la 'brub khung gi liṅga yang bsgral te gtor chen du blug

gtor chen gyi lha bteg byin gyis brlab/ de ma thag 'phral gtor lag tu bzung la/ sha khrag la sogs bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar// ces sogs brjod nas lha mo 'khor bcas kyis gsol bar bsams la 'bul lo// mchod pa dang nang mchod khrag mchod phul/ gtor rdzong byas/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin/ mkha' 'gro phyogs bar dang*/ bstod pa rgyas par bya/ gshegs gtor btang*/ de nas biṣ+ṭi dang ma 'dzoms pa thebs dang bstun nas gtor ma dgra bgegs phyogs su rdeg pa'o// de nas rjes chog byas/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o// zhib par 'og tu bshad pa las shes par bya'o// bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam bzhag brjod zin no// ༈ /na mo ma hā kā lī ye/ bde chen 'gyur med rnam thar gsum gyi dngos// ye shes thab tu ma rungs dgra bgegs kyi// bud shing sreg mdzad 'dod khams gtso mo la// gus pas btud nas las mtha' bshad par bya// 'dir las mtha' sbyin sreg bya ba la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug gi bya ba'o// dang po la thab dang rdzas kyi bsham tshul ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa khru do pa byas la/ khrag chen dang dug dang ro sol gyis nag por byug ro skra'i srad bu thal chen gyis gos par byas la tshangs thig gdab/ gri rus bsregs pa'i dkar gyis dbus su mtshan ma byas/ de'i steng nas mtho re rer yang mtshan ma'i steng nas srad bu mtho do pa gcig bslangs te bya rjes btsal/ tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ tshangs thig mtho gang ba bslangs te/ tshangs thig gnyis par yang mtshan ma bya/ de nyid nas g.yas g.yon du bya rjes btsal la zur thig gdab bo// dbus nas mtho gang sor gnyis nas zlum por bskor/ de nas sor bzhi nas bskor/ yang sor bzhi pas bskor/ mdun gyi zlum po dang tshangs thig phrad mtshams so so'i steng nas/ rgyab phyogs zlum po dang tshangs thig phrad mtshams so sor srad bu 'then nas thig btab pas gru gsum pa gsum rim par 'gyur ro// de nas sor gnyis song ba nas so so'i zur thig gi steng du bya rjes byas la zur thig gdab/

'di rtsig pa la rang 'dra'o// kha khyer la khro bo'i rdo rjes bskor/ nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi dbus su gri gug gi yu ba'i lte ba la bh+yoḥs mtshan pa bris/ dug khrag gis nag por byug zur du gri gug gam/ ral gri'am/ be con bri'o// rdzas ni drag po'i shing tsher ma can nam/ gri ro bsregs pa'i mgal dum sor bcu gnyis pa rnon po bzhogs pa dug khrag gis sbags pa ni yam shing ngo*// tshil chen bsres pa'i mar nag gam tsha ba gsum gyi mar khu/ mi rus kyi phye ma/ sha chen/ me tog nag po/ yungs kar/ ske tshe/ tsha ba gsum/ tsher ma can gyi shing gi 'bru/ dri mi zhim pa'i me tog sngon po/ lha la phul ba'i me tog rnying pa rnams thab kyi g.yon/ rang gi g.yas nas tshur bsham/ thab kyi g.yas rang gi g.yon ngos su/ yungs kar/ yungs nag ske tshe/ lcags phye/ rdo dkar nag gi phye ma rnams dug khrag gis ngar blud la bzhag me lha dang lha mo'i gtor ma gnyis/ 'bru nag dang khrag chen bsres pa'i chu bzhi bsham/ rang gi g.yas su dbang po'i me tog sha chen tshil chen gu gul bsres pa'i spos/ rkang mar tshil chen gyi zhag rnams sbyar ba'i mar me/ dug khrag dang mkhris chen dang zhag dang bsres pa'i dri chab/ sha chen dang sha gsar pas brgyan pa'i zhal zas/ ḍa ma ru rkang gling gi rol mo rnams tshar gnyis phyi nang du bsham/ rang gi mdun du dgang blugs/ mi gsod pa'i chas ral gri'am gri gug de'i g.yon du sla nga'i nang du khrag gi 'brub khung gru gsum rtse mo phar bstan pa bris/ der dgra bo'i zag rdzas/ dri ma/ gcin shul gyi sa/ rkang rjes kyi sa/ gos dri ma can gyi dum bu rnams bsres la/ dug khrag dang sad kyis khyer ba'i nas tshig ma'i phye la liṅga che chung gang rigs bya/ snying gar sngags ban gyi liṅga la zag rdzas byugs pa gzhug de'i dbang po dang lus kyi tshigs rnams su dug tsher btab/ lus ni skem pa/ gnyer ma shig shig tu yod pa/

mig zi ma me ba/ kha dang dbang po nas khrag 'bab pa'o// sa gzhi yangs po la rta dang bong bu/ ma he rnga mong*/ dre'u dang rkyang sogs kyi sbangs dang dri mas sbags pa'i chag chag gdab/ ku sha la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas chas su zhugs/ nang mchod/ bsang chu/ mchod pa/ sreg rdzas/ gtor ma rnams byin gyis brlab/ 'di'i man ngag tu rtab rtob dang tshab tshub tu ma song bar rig pa gding dang ldan pa/ rab tu khros pa'i sems kyis lha mo 'khor bcas la bka' bsgo zhing las 'chol ba'i bsam pa drag po dang ldan pas 'di ltar bya'o// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las sngags brjod la bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥzhes sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gsad khung 'di nyid hūm̐ nag po las grub pa'i gnam lcags kyi 'brub khung kha dog nag po gting yangs pa/ gshin rje'i gsad khang*/ ma mo'i dur sa/ rgyob rgyob chod chod kyi sgra brgyud mar sgrogs pa/ ma rig pa'i mun pa 'thibs pa/ nad kyi bu yug 'tshubs pa/ mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa/ gang chud pa tsam gyis brlag par byed pa'i lcags khang me 'bar ba'i nang du/ gzugs 'di'i snying ga'i ṇi yig gam/ dgra bo'i ming yig dang po las rū pa 'di dang dbyer med pa'i bgegs ming rus che ge mo'i phung po dang*/ khams dang skye mched dang*/ dbang po thams cad dang*/ khyad par rnam shes kyi ngo bo til mar gyi mar me lta bu snying gar gsal bar gyur/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer drag la rtsub pa dmar nag 'phros/ lha mo 'khor bcas skad cig gis bskyed pa'i thugs kar phog khros shing 'khrugs te rang 'dra'i sprul pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros/ de thams cad khros shing 'khrugs/ yul che ge mo nas ming che ge mo zhes bya ba'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/

mgrin pa nas zhag pas bsdams/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings/ yam̐ las byung ba'i rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor la bskyon te/ rgyob rgyob sod sod kyis bsdigs shing rang dbang med par byi'u khras ded pa bzhin du bkug nas liṅga dang sreg rdzas la thim par bsams shing*/ ngag tu rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= bka' sdod dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka'= khyad par du dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ las dang*/ rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis yul che ge mo nas ming rus che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla srung ba'i gur khang la sogs pa gang na gnas kyang*/ mthu stobs kyi bdag mo sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis skad cig gis rang dbang med par 'dir khug gcig ces lan gsum brjod/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o// bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ḥ de wī sarba sha truṃ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sngags sham bu can lan bdun brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstims pas dgra bo dngos su khug par yang yang bsam mo// de ltar kha sbyor byas nas dbye bar bya ba ni/ thog mar srung skyob byed pa'i lha ye shes pa dang dbral ba ni/ kho rang gis bsgrubs pa'i yi dam gyi lha dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i kho rang gi srung ma rnams mngon sum du yod par dmigs la/ de rnams la dgra bo 'di'i nyes pa bsgrag par bya'o/ bh+yoḥ

lha mo 'khor bcas snyan gson cig /yi dam lha tshogs= /chos skyong srung ma= /yul lha gzhi bdag= khyed rnams gzu dang dpang po ste// bdag gis dmigs pa'i dgra bo 'di// nam yang yal bar mi btang ngo*// dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can 'dis// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la bsdos// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra byas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun so sor phyes// skye bo yongs la gnod cing 'tshe// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med byas// srung ma khyod la bsdo phod btsugs// rnal 'byor bdag la gnod pa byas// dge 'dun zhal gyi 'du sgo phrogs// ma nyes sems can brlag par byas// zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs 'di'i// srung dang skyob pa ma mdzad par// 'di nyid brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces brjod pas/ ye shes pa de thams cad srin po khros pa lta bur gyur nas/ kho pa'i lus las snying dang rgyu ma dang nang rol thams cad drangs te rang la thim pas mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par bsams la/ snying po la sarba sha truṃ/ sarba de wī/ bhi ti sha ya phaṭa/ ces bzlas so// rang dang lha mo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i ma mo'i tshogs lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa rnams kyis dgra bgegs de dag la sngags mkhan gzhan gyis byas pa'i srung ba dang 'khor lo dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha dang srung ma thams cad lcags kyus btab cing zhags pas drangs nas/ rang gi g.yon phyogs su 'brub khung du bcug gzhan du 'byung ba ltar bur gdab bya'o// yang pho nya rnams spros/ dgra bgegs de dag gis srung ba'i don du btags pa'i go cha dang*/ nor bu dang rdzas sogs bcangs pa thams cad bkug nas sngar ltar ro// de nas gu gul/ yugs mo'i dor rta/ khyi lud/ rta bon/ bse nag mu zi/ za 'og dum bu/ bshan pa'i l+h+wam 'bob rnams kham por du sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu rang la du ba ye mi phog pa'i rlung phyogs legs par brtags te/

liṅga shing ngam dug gi rtse mo la bskyon te bdug go /de ltar byas pas dgra bgegs de dag mgon skyabs thams cad dang bral bas bkrag mdangs med pa nyam thag pa/ rang la rgyab bstan te rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'dar hed hed gnas par bsam mo// bskul ni/ bh+yoḥ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma ti// zhes pa nas/ dgra bo'i yul khams myur du brlag par gyis// dgra bo 'di dag myur du gsad par gyis// dgra dang bgegs kyi sha zo// zhes sogs man gong bzhin no// ral gri'am gri gug gis gtubs te dum bu brgya la sogs pa byas/ liṅga dum bu re dang*/ sha dum bu re sbrags la khrag gis dmar ldeg ste byugs/ me lha dang lha mo 'khor bcas la 'bul rgyu so sor bzhag de nas thab bskyed pa ni/ gdol pa'i khyim nas me blangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bzla zhing me gsos/ oṃ dz+wa la ram̐ zhes sbar ro/ hūm̐ zhes rlung g.yab/ mar khu blug gzar gsum gyis me gso/ skabs 'dir me sgra chen po 'bar ba dang*/ tsheg sgra dang*/ me lce dum bur 'chad cing 'bar ba dang*/ dri mi zhim pa snom pa sogs ni las myur du 'grub pa'i rtags so// de nas thab bskyed/ bsang chu dang nang mchod kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ nag po zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab kha dog nag po dbyibs gru gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ ram̐ las me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su ra skyes kyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng*/ de yongs su gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa drang srong gi cha byad can/ smin ma dang sma ra dkar ser 'bar ba/ g.yas gnyis gri gug dang be con/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ khros pa zhal gdangs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang dang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gis bskor ba spyan drangs/

hūm̐ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po'i tshogs// lha yi drang srong bram ze'i mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha= pā d+yaṃ/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod dbul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// mar khu blug gzar bdun phul la/ me lha 'khor bcas kyis dgra bgegs thams cad myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig me lha'i ljags la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blug kha la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces yam shing phul/ rdzas thams cad me lha'i sngags nyid kyis 'bul/ de nas liṅga'i dum bu sha dum mar khu gsum sbyar ba byas te lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs phul te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad dang*/ dgra bo dmigs bsal ba 'di nyid mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces re re'i mthar spel tshig sbyor ba'am/ yang na thams cad kyang mjug tu nges par brjod do// de nas me lha'i thugs kar lha mo 'khor bcas gsar du bskyed pa'am/ spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol ba gang rung byas/

gsar du bskyed na de'i thugs kar dre'u rkyang ser gwa pa'i steng du bh+yoḥlas bskyed/ spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par byas/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ chu bzhi phul/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ snying po la yi ge gsum btags la nang mchod phul/ yang na phra mo sbom po sogs kyis phul/ rak+ta'ang de bzhin no// 'phral gtor gtong*/ bstod pa byas te/ lha mo 'khor bcas kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ 'bar bas mtshan par gyur/ mar khu blugs gzar bdun phul te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu/ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig bsreg rdzas rim pas/ bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥ rak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ yul che ge mo nas dgra bo che ge mo ming dang rus che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di a mu ka sarba sha truṃ/ ru lu ru lu/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ māṃ sa ru dhi ra tsit+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si/ tsa pa la a shu me hūm̐ bh+yoḥ spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar la phul/ khyad par liṅga'i dum po/ sha gsar pa/ glo snying dum bu/ khrag mar khu rnams bzhi sbrags su byas te/ brgya'am nyer gcig skabs dang sbyar nas phul/ na mo rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ā tsār+ya dmar po nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar bsgrubs bsgrubs pa/ mchod mchod pa/ bsten bsten pa'i srung ma dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo/ las mkhan gdong can rnam gnyis/ bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu/ khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang*/

bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas dang bcas pa la snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ khyad par du yul ming rus che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad a mu ka sarba sha trūṃ ru lu ru lu/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ māṃ sa tsit+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ spel tshig dang bcas te 'bul lo// mchod phreng dang bcas te/ chu bzhi nyer spyod/ 'dod yon/ nang mchod/ rak+ta/ gtor ma rnams 'bul/ yig brgya bzlas/ nyes pa bzod par gsol/ kā lī de wī badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs pa dang*/ slar spyan drang ba skabs su gang bab bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// de nas me lha la bsreg rdzas lhag ma yod na 'bul/ gtor ma me lha'i sngags la kha 'bar ma btags la phul/ mchod pa nang mchod kyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ ar+ghaṃ phul/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin don la 'dir gshegs la// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs// badz+ra muḥ me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ gsum pa ni/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyad/ lhag gtor btang*/ bkra shis brjod/ bsreg rdzas kyi rgyu rabs chad nag po'i sha khrag bya rog 'ug pa'i sha tshil/ seṅge/ stag bya rgod/ kyung ka'i snying*/ rta nag ra rog po/ phag nag gi snying*/ spyang ki mo'i snying*/ nal bu'i snying*/ dug khrag cong zhi/ gi hang rnams sbyar ba'i ril bu khri tsho bzhi byas te/ ru ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba to si/ tsa pa la/ a shu me/ ma ma sarba sha trūṃ/ a mu ka shī gh+raṃ mā ra ṇa/ dz+wa la ti/ tsi ti dz+wa la dz+wi baṃ/ ru dhi ra/ mā ra ya/ nā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ril bu'i rdzas dang mnyam pa'i sngags bzlas te ril bu sbyin sreg byas na tsha ba'i nad kyis dgra bo myur du brlag par 'gyur ro// thal ba'ang rdzi phyogs nas dgra phyogs su rlung la bskur ro// shu bhaṃ//
